s1.desc: a dining corner drawn on a plain pale grey background, with a round cream table on a pale aqua pedestal and two wooden chairs

spans.notes: Insert: Polly's flipper lowers a striped ice cream tub onto the table next to a spoon; 20 frames, lead only as a flipper.

spans.view: with a striped tub of ice cream in the middle of the table

beats.text: Polly lets go of the ice cream tub and clasps her flippers by her cheek with a happy grin while Pax holds up his spoon
Pax leans over the table and pulls the lid off the tub while Polly waits with her eyes closed, smiling
Pax and Polly dip their spoons into the tub and scoop up some ice cream
Pax and Polly each lift a heaped spoon of ice cream and hold it out over the table

spans.notes: Ends at f78: a quick push-in runs f79-83.
Quick push-in: table+shadow bbox 424 -> 481 px wide (540 px frame) between f78 and f84.

spans.view: with a striped tub of ice cream and its lid on the table

beats.text: Pax eats the ice cream off his own spoon with his eyes closed while Polly holds her spoon out toward him
Pax opens his eyes and keeps the spoon at his beak while Polly holds her spoon out toward him
Polly's face flushes red and she flings her spoon up and away
Polly turns her face away with her eyes squeezed shut while Pax looks over at her
Polly sits with her flippers crossed and a flushed, scowling face while Pax holds his spoon and stares at her
Pax blows hard on the ice cream on his spoon and the scoop flies off toward Polly
Polly winces as the scoop splats onto her forehead, her flippers still crossed
Pax stares at Polly with wide worried eyes and sweat drops while she sulks with ice cream stuck on her forehead
Pax scoops more ice cream from the tub and holds the spoon out to Polly's beak while she keeps scowling
Polly snatches the spoon out of Pax's flipper and turns away with it, scowling, while Pax stares

spans.notes: Polly's angry flush is a soft red glow across her face (in-style). The thrown spoon leaves the picture at the top. beats.text: Polly hops down from her chair clutching the ice cream tub and spoon while Pax watches her blankly
Polly slips out past the right edge while Pax scratches his head with a sheepish blush
